name: governance-pack
title: Workspace governance review pack
for_each: select id,code from tenants order by code

sections.title: Findings
sections.note: Findings flag records for review. They do not establish legal compliance or change Microsoft settings.
sections.sql: select external_id,name,rule,finding from governance_findings where tenant_id=$1 order by external_id,rule

sections.title: Review decisions
sections.sql: select external_id,name,kind,reviewer,due_on,status,decision,current_snapshot,decision_evidence,completion_evidence from review_register where tenant_id=$1 order by created_at

name: decision-record
title: Workspace review decision record
for_each: select id,name from review_register order by id

sections.title: Review and evidence
sections.note: Completion is an operator-reported verification of work performed elsewhere. This system has no live Microsoft connection.
